acceptance: Diff output is machine-readable and consumable by future UI/CLI without reconstructing history from prose.

positive.fixture: committed reports match the emitter and validate against the published schema in TypeScript
positive.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-versioning --test report; pnpm --filter @vsf/cross-language-tests run test

negative.fixture: a report with an unknown class, extra field, bad digest or missing summary is refused by the schema

security_and_source_permissions: Reports carry digests and paths, not source data.
